rows.grounds: sky-goer; one who moves in the sky
middle present third singular of jan

items.question: What transformation is promised to one who goes at night to a crossroads?
premises: Going at night to crossroads yields khechara status.
The goddess is addressed as witness to this result.
items.inference: The verse promises khechara attainment through nocturnal crossroads practice.
uncertainties: The exact ritual context of khechara is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: O goddess, one becomes a sky-goer by going at night to a crossroads.
